publication.title: Semantic faceted search with aggregation and recursion

source_reading.scope: Motivation and worked product graph, core/extended facet-interface mappings, comparison/aggregate/reachability semantics, query-answering algorithm/theorem, containment results and conclusions. Formal statements and derivation sketches read; no independent proof certification or full line-by-line proof attestation.

adjudication.basis: The report defines concrete RDF faceted interaction extensions for numeric ranges, aggregation and reachability shortcuts and analyzes their query semantics. Its conclusion states that SemFacet was extended for numeric ranges and aggregation; reachability implementation remains in progress. The protocol admits this interaction method and qualified prototype claim without requiring a new deployed experiment.

studies.design: Formal semantics, query-answering algorithm and containment complexity results
studies.results: Theorem1: extended faceted query answering is polynomial. Theorem2: containment is coNP-complete for specified disjunctive/mixed-reachability fragments. Theorem3: conjunctive fragments using either Next or Next+ separately have PTIME containment.
limitations: Asymptotic tractability is not empirical latency or usability. Aggregate restrictions differ from full SPARQL1.1 and use sets rather than multisets.
